name: codiscover
description: Turn real work challenges into prioritized, responsible, and testable Human-AI use cases.

interface.shortDescription: Discover testable Human-AI work use cases.
interface.longDescription: CoDiscover helps people frame a real work challenge, compare Human-AI opportunities, expose trade-offs and risks, and design a minimum test with explicit human accountability.
defaultPrompt: Find high-impact AI use cases for this work challenge.
Compare these AI use cases and recommend the next test.
Sharpen this idea into a responsible Human-AI experiment.
